use_cases: Display loading states during async operations like data fetching or file uploads
Indicate progress when waiting for page transitions or component hydration
Show processing feedback during form submissions or API calls
Use as a placeholder while content is being loaded dynamically
Add visual feedback to interactive elements during user-triggered operations
ai_summary: A minimalist SVG-based loading spinner inspired by Vercel's design language. The component renders geometric line segments with varying opacity levels to create a subtle gradient-like visual effect. It supports customizable size through props and integrates seamlessly as an inline-flex element within any layout.
